BLOCKS.name: Hero / Page Header
variations: Heading + subcopy + optional image/CTA; on 73 pages
Title + author/date/read-time meta + eyebrow; used on dynamic article/listing pages
BLOCKS.behavior: Background image/color, optional eyebrow, breadcrumb slot. Structurally similar across product/landing/legal; article variant adds post metadata.
BLOCKS.eds: One hero block with a variant class (e.g. hero / hero.article). Breadcrumb rendered separately. Image via EDS optimized picture.

BLOCKS.name: Feature Cards & Media Row
variations: Alternating image/text rows; the workhorse content block
BLOCKS.behavior: Image left/right alternation, optional CTA, rich text body. Left/right + background toggles are authoring options, not separate blocks.
BLOCKS.eds: Single block; image side + background are section/authoring options. Maps cleanly to an EDS columns/cards pattern.

BLOCKS.name: Icon / Image / Feature Cards
BLOCKS.behavior: Repeating card collections rendered in responsive grids. Differ by media type (icon vs image) — a meaningful authoring/structural difference.
BLOCKS.eds: One "cards" block with icon vs image variant. Grid columns responsive by count.

BLOCKS.name: Line-Tab Feature (Tabbed content)
variations: Tab strip along the top; tab → card panel
Tab list on the side; tab → card panel
BLOCKS.behavior: Interactive tab switching (client JS), ARIA tablist/tabpanel, keyboard nav. Horizontal vs vertical differ in layout + interaction model.
BLOCKS.eds: Tabs block with orientation variant. Needs JS decoration for tab state, ARIA roles, and deep-link/anchor support.

BLOCKS.name: Progress Bar / Stepper
variations: Ordered “how it works / next steps” 3–5 step sequence
BLOCKS.behavior: Presentational stepped sequence (not a form wizard). Each step = icon/number + heading + text.
BLOCKS.eds: Static stepper block; no state machine. CSS-driven connectors. Low interactivity.

BLOCKS.name: Video (Wistia)
variations: Wistia web component (<wistia-video>) with poster + heading + copy
BLOCKS.behavior: Uses Wistia player web-component + Wistia embed script (videoType:"wistia"). YouTube appears only as outbound links inside rich text, not as an embed.
BLOCKS.eds: Video block with lazy facade → Wistia embed. Load player script only on interaction/delayed phase for CWV.

BLOCKS.name: Metrics / Stats
variations: Large-number + label KPI row (e.g. financial-strength, about)
BLOCKS.behavior: Static numeric highlights. No animation/data source observed.
BLOCKS.eds: Simple stats block; author-entered numbers.

BLOCKS.name: Rich Text Row
variations: Formatted prose section (headings, lists, links, tables inline)
BLOCKS.behavior: Default rich-text content. Baseline authoring surface.
BLOCKS.eds: Default content — no block needed beyond section styling; handled by core decoration.

BLOCKS.name: Image Block
variations: Full-width / inline image with optional caption
BLOCKS.behavior: Single responsive image, optional caption/alt.
BLOCKS.eds: Core image handling via EDS optimized <picture>.

BLOCKS.name: CTA Block
variations: Heading + copy + one/more buttons on a colored band
BLOCKS.behavior: Promotional band with buttons (data-gtm click tracking attributes present).
BLOCKS.eds: CTA block; buttons decorated from links. Preserve GTM data-attributes for analytics parity.

BLOCKS.name: Accordion / Disclosure
variations: Collapsible fine-print / disclaimer region (very common footer-of-content)
BLOCKS.behavior: Both are expand/collapse; accordion is multi-item FAQ, disclosure is single legal expander. Distinct authoring purpose + placement.
BLOCKS.eds: Accordion block with a "disclosure" variant. ARIA disclosure pattern, keyboard support.

BLOCKS.name: Blog Card / Related Posts
variations: Curated card links to insight articles
BLOCKS.behavior: Related-posts is data-driven (pulls related Insights); cards render title/image/excerpt/link. Depends on content taxonomy.
BLOCKS.eds: Card block + a query-driven variant (index/taxonomy) for related posts. Needs an index (e.g. EDS query-index.json).

BLOCKS.name: Dynamic Content Listing (Insights index)
variations: Paginated article feed ("BlogPosts", "Pagination", "articles" in payload); SSR renders shell, list hydrates client-side
BLOCKS.behavior: List of posts with pagination is fetched/rendered client-side (empty in SSR HTML). Category/feed driven.
BLOCKS.eds: Listing block backed by an EDS index (query-index.json) with pagination; replaces the client feed. Higher effort due to data model + pagination.

BLOCKS.name: Brochure / Resource Collection
variations: Tabbed groups of downloadable resource cards (client-engagement-collections has 28 cards / 7 tabs)
BLOCKS.behavior: Tabbed sets of downloadable cards; each card links to an asset (asset.american-equity.com / resolve-by-key). Combines tabs + card grid + downloads.
BLOCKS.eds: Composite block: tabs + downloadable cards. Links resolve to DAM assets (reuse resolver). Medium-High due to tab + asset wiring.

BLOCKS.name: Attachments / Download List
variations: List of downloadable documents (PDF via resolver / asset host)
BLOCKS.behavior: Renders document links (statements, guides). Links point to the DAM resolver or asset host.
BLOCKS.eds: Downloads block; author supplies asset links. Reuse existing resolver/asset URLs.

BLOCKS.name: Form Listing (searchable forms/docs)
variations: Search box + category tabs over a form/document set (consumer /forms, document-library)
BLOCKS.behavior: Search + filter/tab UI over a data set that hydrates client-side (SSR shell only). Card/table item links resolve to DAM assets.
BLOCKS.eds: Listing block with client search/filter over an index; rows link to DAM. Higher effort: search UX + data model.

BLOCKS.name: Native Form (Form Input Model)
variations: Server/native form: text inputs, select, textarea, submit (template/demo page /form)
BLOCKS.behavior: Only truly native <form> in scope (placeholder "Form title/description" labels — appears to be a template/sample). Submission endpoint not confirmed from SSR.
BLOCKS.eds: Form block (or AEM Forms) — needs field model, validation, and a confirmed submit endpoint. Flagged as gray area.

BLOCKS.name: Third-Party Embed (Script Row)
BLOCKS.behavior: Container that injects a 3rd-party script + mount node. Actual functionality (forms, calculator, job board) lives in the external app.
BLOCKS.eds: Generic "embed/script" block that mounts a vendor script into a placeholder. Preserve embeds; do not rebuild vendor apps.

BLOCKS.name: Contact Card / Row
BLOCKS.behavior: Static contact detail cards with tel:/mailto: links.
BLOCKS.eds: Cards variant; author-entered contact info.

BLOCKS.name: Modal / Dialog
BLOCKS.behavior: Overlay dialog; focus trap + ARIA dialog semantics.
BLOCKS.eds: Modal block/util; accessible dialog, opened from a trigger link.

BLOCKS.name: Global Header / Navigation
variations: 4 top-level menus (About Us, Annuities, Retirement Resources, Support) with dropdown panels + utility menu (Login/Register/Search) + Find an Agent
BLOCKS.behavior: Desktop mega-menu (navigation-menu triggers + content panels), mobile drawer, utility links to external portal/register. GTM nav tracking attributes.
BLOCKS.eds: Standard EDS header block from nav document; mega-menu panels + mobile drawer. External utility links preserved.

BLOCKS.name: Global Footer
variations: Nav columns + social links (Facebook/LinkedIn) + legal/disclosure + logo; ~10 link cols site-wide
BLOCKS.behavior: Static multi-column footer with social + legal links and rich disclosure text. GTM footer tracking attributes.
BLOCKS.eds: Standard EDS footer block from footer document.

BLOCKS.name: Breadcrumb
BLOCKS.behavior: Path breadcrumb on interior pages; not present on home/some landings.
BLOCKS.eds: Breadcrumb block/auto-block derived from path or metadata.
